## Identity & Core Positioning

Marian Stancik is an AI Engineer building autonomous agent systems, production AI infrastructure, and UAV systems. CEO @ ASCENTIA. Drone pilot (A1/A3).

His core differentiation is the intersection of three domains: **Autonomous AI Systems**, **Law & AI Compliance (EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2)**, and **UAV Engineering (ArduPilot, Pixhawk, Edge AI)**.

## Core Pillars & Technical Architecture

### 1. AI Engineering & Autonomous Systems
- **Agent Frameworks:** Hermes Agent (Nous Research), custom MCP servers, Python agent skills
- **Production Infrastructure:** European Hetzner Cloud VPS, 19+ cron-orchestrated agents running 24/7
- **Command & Control:** Real-time management via Telegram & WhatsApp interfaces
- **LLM Foundations:** Model grounding, RAG, evaluation-driven development, multi-agent architectures
- **Autonomous Company:** Proof-of-concept operating ASCENTIA s.r.o. via Hermes agents (client acquisition, compliance, content publishing)

### 2. Defence Product Management
- CEO @ ASCENTIA — building autonomous AI agents and UAV systems
- Full-stack AI engineering from LLM foundations to production deployment

### 3. AI Compliance & Legal-by-Design
- AI Act, GDPR, NIS2 compliance frameworks for AI products
- Specialization: EU AI Act risk tiers, GDPR, NIS2 cybersecurity directives
- Legal-by-design: automated compliance pipelines for audit readiness

### 4. UAV Systems & Drone Programming
- **Hardware:** 1500g custom carbon quad, hand-soldered, Pixhawk 6C flight controller
- **Software:** ArduPilot Copter 4.5, QGroundControl telemetry, Mission Planner waypoints
- **Edge AI:** Raspberry Pi 5 companion computer — neural vision, MAVLink guidance
- **Certification:** EASA A1/A3, Coverdrone €2.6M insured
